name: gradle-install-debug
description: Build and install the debug APK on a connected Android device via `./gradlew installDebug`. Runs from the project root (or the provided working_directory). Requires a connected device or emulator — check with adb-devices first. After installation, use adb-launch to start the app and android-logcat to monitor it.

subcommand.name: installDebug
subcommand.description: Compile the debug variant and install it on all connected Android devices. Fails if no device is connected.

options.name: offline
options.description: Build without network access (uses the Gradle dependency cache).

options.name: stacktrace
options.description: Print the full stack trace if the build fails.

subcommand.install_instructions: Android Studio includes the Android Gradle Plugin. ADB must be installed: brew install android-platform-tools

custom.workflow: adb-devices → gradle-install-debug → adb-launch → adb-pid-of → android-logcat (with pid+serial)
custom.tip: If the build fails with a Gradle wrapper error, ensure gradlew is executable: chmod +x gradlew
